title: Lancaster Royal Grammar School - WW1 and WW2
memorial_details:
description: OVER ENTRANCE DOORS: THIS LIBRARY PERPETUATES THE MEMORY OF/ FORMER MEMBERS OF THIS SCHOOL, WHOSE/ LIVES WERE SACRIFICED IN THE SERVICE OF/ THEIR KING AND COUNTRY DURING THE GREAT/ WAR, 1914 - 1918. LET ALL WHO ENTER IT PAY/ THEM THE TRIBUTE OF SILENCE

NAME PLAQUES - TO THE GLORY OF GOD AND IN HONOURED MEMORY OF/ THE OLD LANCASTRIANS WHO GAVE THEIR LIVES FOR THEIR/ KING AND COUNTRY IN THE GREAT WAR 1914 - 1918/ (NAMES IN 5 COLUMNS)/ THE NAMES OF THESE ALSO LIVE FOR EVERMORE/ 1939 - 1945/ (NAMES IN 6 COLUMNS)

LAMP OF REMEMBRANCE: 1914 - 1918/ DULCE/ ET DECORUM/ EST/ PRO PATRIA/ MORI
